_comment: Standalone configuration example. Three modes are supported — pick one and delete the others.
_mode_comment: --- Mode A: HA WebSocket events (requires a long-lived access token) ---
_mode_b_comment: --- Mode B: MQTT only — no HA token required. Set mode.ha_events=false, mode.mqtt=true ---
_mode_c_comment: --- Mode C: HTTP API only — set both mode flags to false. No events pushed anywhere. ---
